analyst.summary: Ion Exchange is a long-established Indian water and wastewater treatment company spanning specialty chemicals, engineering/EPC project execution, and consumer water purifiers under the Zero B brand. Growth has slowed and profitability has weakened over the past year, with margins compressing and debt rising — most likely reflecting strain in the project-execution business rather than a problem with the underlying franchise. The long-term structural case (tightening water and effluent regulation) remains intact, but the near-term numbers argue for caution rather than conviction.
